name: Virginia Roberts Giuffre
role: American survivor of Jeffrey Epstein's trafficking and advocate for abuse survivors (1983-2025)
summary: Giuffre was known as a survivor and accuser of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, and founded a nonprofit for abuse and trafficking survivors. Her public statements concern her own case and survivors' voices rather than general political positions, and the bills and campaigns named after her were pushed by her family after her death.

sources.title: Giuffre family, survivors and lawmakers to introduce Virginia's Law
sources.author: KUTV / Scripps News
sources.usedFor: Shows the 2026 bill named for her was introduced with her family; the article quotes no position of her own
